g.text: Crafty — Codex through ACP, with durable application state
chosen version + image / MCP / resume capabilities
Register the reader and request handlers before session setup.
Drain stderr separately. Authentication uses private agent state.
capture several views; annotate selected images
atomically save message + turn + dispatch command
dispatch once; hold per-chat turn ownership
open local image with image-view tool
Keep this request open through the entire v1 turn.
Continue reading updates AND agent requests concurrently.
Files are the baseline image handoff; opening them provides vision input.
ACP inline image blocks are an optional alternative.
Tool returns promptly. The agent can end its turn.
Form or capture submission becomes a later user message.
Native ACP elicitation is a separately negotiated capability.
ingest completed bytes; create immutable asset
upload frozen source; create job with active turn scope
stage STEP output; complete build attempt
read build state; fetch completed outputs
ingest exact local files; create publication operation
reopen submitted STEP -> validate -> GLB + PNG
check lease + cancellation fence; publish revision atomically
model_publish also accepts an already available local STEP + source.
Build completion and model publication have separate job states.
Agent can fetch the published verification PNG for visual review.
revoke job publication for this turn
stop attempt containers; discard unpublished outputs
mark turn cancelled; release prompt slot
Pending permission requests resolve as cancelled.
A deadline without acknowledgement fences the old runtime.
Late frames remain diagnostics; they cannot publish a revision.
replay application events or snapshot + cursor
Browser reconnect does not create or reload an ACP session.
Only runtime recovery uses negotiated session/resume or session/load.
